missed_functions.why: V126 requires the port switch to block current from the pin back into the rail (pin up to 12 V, switch on and off), and V302 (owner, 2026-10-02) names 'separate reverse blocking' as a part of the split topology. P2's rank 1 for Port supply switch, TLP3545A(TP1,F, takes this from the companion CMS04(TE12L,Q,M) (jlcparts C603062: 30 V, 5 A, 370 mV at 5 A, reverse leakage 8 mA at 30 V; the leakage at 8.4 V against V125's 5 mA is not read), and P2 states that selection.json holds one part a function and that the companions need functions of their own. P2 returned no entry for it: it carries its Schottky candidates (FSV1045V, SDT10A45P5-13, SS10P4-M3/86A) as drops under Port supply switch, so no part for it can reach selection.json.

V123 requires each port switch to limit its own current with the whole tolerance band between 3.0 and 6.35 A, and V302 names 'current limit' as a separate part of the split topology. P2's rank 1 takes it from the companion INA301A1IDGKR, which P2 says needs a function of its own because selection.json holds one part a function. P2 returned no entry and no requirements for it (limit band, trip against the 5 ms opening limit, 20 per board against a gate of 500, the alert's action on the photorelay LED), so the companion is unqualified in selection.json.
